title: The Unofficial Scholarship
author: Freya Delacroix
blurb: Kestrel Whitlock, the new kid at a school built over something old, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
